notice: BORRADOR SIN VERIFICAR. Ocho habilidades técnicas de dominio tomadas del catálogo de PerfiladorV2 (Supabase, tabla skill_taxonomy, consultada por Dev el 29-oct-2026 en solo lectura). Los nombres en español son traducción provisional de Dev; el territorio «Ingeniería y Sistemas» es provisional. NO traen criterios de nivel: PerfiladorV2 usa una escala de 1 a 5 con anclas en 1, 3 y 5, y Elevation usa 4 niveles con criterios completos en ES y EN; no se convierte la escala ni se inventan niveles. Alejo o el especialista completan los 4 niveles, la fuente, el verificador y la fecha desde el backoffice antes de publicar.
source: PerfiladorV2 · skill_taxonomy (8 filas). No se importan seniority_benchmarks ni gap_vs_target.

reference.descriptionEn: Designs modular boundaries, keeps domain logic isolated, and applies dependency inversion pragmatically.

anchors.1: Tangled responsibilities and framework-coupled domain logic
anchors.3: Mostly separated layers with occasional leakage
anchors.5: Clear boundaries, testable core, and pragmatic dependency direction

reference.descriptionEn: Reasons about scale, trade-offs, data ownership, failure modes, and operational constraints.

anchors.3: Covers basic scaling and persistence trade-offs
anchors.5: Models load, consistency, resilience, observability, and cost trade-offs

reference.descriptionEn: Designs stable API boundaries with validation, versioning, compatibility, and useful errors.

anchors.5: Versioned contracts with compatibility and consumer-aware error design

reference.descriptionEn: Uses transactions, locking, indexing, query plans, and isolation levels to protect data correctness and performance.

anchors.1: Unsafe string SQL or non-atomic updates
anchors.3: Uses parameterized queries and basic transactions
anchors.5: Handles isolation, locks, indexes, and contention deliberately

labels.es: Rigor en la revisión de código

reference.descriptionEn: Reviews code for correctness, maintainability, security, tests, and architectural fit.

anchors.1: Reviews mostly style or approves superficially
anchors.5: Surfaces systemic risks and teaches through clear, actionable feedback

reference.descriptionEn: Designs logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and incident feedback loops for production systems.

anchors.1: Debugs mostly by logs after failures
anchors.3: Adds useful metrics and basic alerts
anchors.5: Defines SLOs, traces critical flows, and improves systems after incidents

reference.descriptionEn: Balances unit, integration, contract, and edge-case tests around business risk.

anchors.3: Covers happy paths and important edge cases
anchors.5: Risk-based test pyramid with deterministic integration and regression coverage

reference.descriptionEn: Prevents injection and unsafe input paths with validation, encoding, and least privilege.

anchors.1: Trusts raw input or concatenates untrusted data
anchors.3: Validates common cases and parameterizes queries
anchors.5: Applies layered validation, safe encoding, and abuse-case thinking
